activity_summary: You ate at the lodging and said you were in the comedy at two. The loaf was still shrunk on the pan. Verbeke said the close had been quiet on his way to the loom. You did not open a book.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said he was in the comedy, and that he would want supper rather than dinner.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Sent him off without a speech about the price.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Remembered the landlady's old verdict on the comedy, and was told to let it lie.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Said the close had been quiet on the way to the loom.
